_comment: Variant adapter table for the Claude Code host: every seat runs as its own headless `claude -p` subprocess against a self-hosted vllm endpoint. Selected per run with CLAUDE_CODE_ADAPTER_TABLE (a bare file name in this directory); claude-code.json stays the default and keeps the in-process Agent tool path. See docs/architecture/adapter-interface.md for the subprocess spawn mode and .claude/adapters/claude-code-subprocess.mjs for the mechanism.
description: Claude Code adapter, self-hosted variant. Spawns each seat as a `claude -p` subprocess on a local vllm model, one launch per package worktree. The settings profile is named by a placeholder the run expands from its own environment, never an absolute path.
_effort_comment: Self-hosted vllm carries no marginal token cost, so this table lifts the paid-API effort policy to the max ceiling with nothing forbidden (effort-policy.test.mjs keys the exemption by host+provider: claude-code + vllm). The default claude-code.json keeps xhigh and forbids max.
